description: This file defines the main class 'Image_Graph' used for creating and rendering various types of graphs and charts. It manages the canvas, handles layout, error display, and output, and includes factory methods for creating different graph elements, layouts, and handling output formats.

classes.name: Image_Graph
classes.description: Main class for creating, managing, and rendering graphs and charts, managing canvas, layout, error handling, and output.

methods.name: Image_Graph
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the graph with parameters such as size, canvas type, or an existing canvas object.

methods.name: setCanvas
methods.description: Sets or replaces the canvas used for rendering the graph.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the graph as defined by the canvas.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the graph as defined by the canvas.

methods.name: displayErrors
methods.description: Enables the display of errors on the output.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Configures logging for errors (not implemented in this snippet).

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory method for creating various graph elements or objects based on class name or alias.

methods.name: layoutFactory
methods.description: Creates layout objects (vertical or horizontal) with two parts and a split percentage.

methods.name: _default_error_handler
methods.description: Handles PHP errors, converts them into internal error logs.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes the graph rendering, outputs the graph through the canvas, and optionally includes timing and error display.
